cut.from_x_measured_from: the part's own minimum x (its fixed end), not the build frame origin
cut.rule: every element beyond from_x whose z extent crosses the kerf band is removed; what lies before it keeps the part on the plate

inherent_strain.source: Demonstration eigenstrain tensor; not a calibrated machine or material

material.note: a body loaded only by an eigenstrain has a displacement field that does not depend on the modulus; it sets the stresses

spec_hash_covers: every field except job_id, created, project_revision and spec_hash
